items.title: Why Hims & Hers Health (HIMS) Stock Is Nosediving
items.summary: Shares of telehealth company Hims & Hers Health (NYSE:HIMS) fell 9.2% in the afternoon session after Bloomberg reported that Visa enrolled the telehealth company in its Acquirer Monitoring Program following a surge in customer credit card disputes in its weight-loss subscription business.

items.title: Which Credit Card Stock Has Dominated in 2026: Visa, Mastercard, or American Express?
items.summary: Visa, Mastercard, and American Express usually move in loose lockstep, but 2026 has cracked that relationship wide open in a way that forces investors to pick sides between two very different business models.

items.title: Visa Charges Toward New All-Time Closing High
items.summary: Visa shares jumped nearly 3% in Monday afternoon trading, positioning the payments giant for a new all-time closing high, based on data going back to 2008. Shares are currently hovering around $381. The gain sets Visa on course for its fifth consecutive winning day; shares climbed about 6% over the period.
